name: Swecon
blurb: Sweden's national science-fiction convention, rotating host city each year; the 2026 edition is 'Fantastika', held near Stockholm.

editions.evidence: Homepage title/text: 'FANTASTIKA 2026 SF CONVENTION IN STOCKHOLM – OCTOBER 23 – 25, 2026' and 'Fantastika 2026 är en sf-kongress som kommer att äga rum i Dieselverkstaden i Sickla nära Stockholms centrum, 23-25 oktober 2026.'

notes: Batch URL (fandom.se/swecon) is the general, long-stale Swecon info page (still describes 'Fantastika 2020'); replaced with this year's actual convention site, fantastika2026.com, which is reused/relabeled year to year by the Stockholm-area SF club that is hosting in 2026 (per its own text, this venue has hosted the con in 2013/2016/2018/2021/2022/2024 too). The site's own nav link labelled 'Hedersgäster' (Guests of Honour) resolves to a stale 2021 page at /hedersgaster/; the current 2026 guest page is at /hedersgaster-4/ (found via WebFetch of the live nav), which lists Maura McHugh, Anna Gustafsson Chen and Gareth L. Powell with photos and bios — all three picked. Swecon rotates to a different host city each year by member vote (typically decided at the current year's convention), so no 2027 location/site is announced yet; only the 2026 edition is listed.
